resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Assignment Operators[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

The simple [b]assignment [/b]operator (=) assigns the right side to the left side. 

C++ provides shorthand operators that have the capability of performing an operation and an assignment at the same time. 
[s0l0!-header][b]For example: [/b][/s0l0!-header] [code format="cpp" ]int x = 10;
[b]x += 4[/b]; // equivalent to x = x + 4
[b]x -= 5[/b]; // equivalent to x = x - 5[/code]
[note]Assignment operator (=) assigns the right side to the left side.[/note]

resolved.title: 机器人打字
resolved.problem_statement_md:
一个机器人打字速度为每分钟**300**个字母。
给定的程序，输入**时间**（以分钟为单位）。

请完成代码，计算并输出在给定时间内机器人打出的字母数。
resolved.problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Assignment and increment operators[/h1][/s0l0!-header]

A robot can type [b]300 letters per minute[/b].
The given program takes the text input [b]time [/b](in minutes).

[b]Task[/b]
Complete the code to calculate and output the number of letters that will be typed in a given time.

[b]Sample Input[/b]
20

[b]Sample Output[/b]
6000

[b]Hint[/b]
To calculate the length of the text, you need to [b]multiply [/b]the [b]time [/b]by a [b]count [/b](letters per minute).

[note]Use the *= shorthand for easier calculation.[/note]
resolved.hint_md:
- 要计算总共打字数，你需要用**时间**乘以**打字速度**（每分钟的字母）。
- 为了方便计算，使用`*=`速记法。

resolved.title: 自减运算符
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Decrement Operator[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

The [b]decrement [/b]operator (--) works in much the same way as the increment operator, but instead of increasing the value, it decreases it by one.[code format="cpp" ]--x; // prefix
x--; // postfix[/code]
[note]The decrement operator (--) works in much the same way as the increment operator.[/note]
